chore: prepare the release of cmaf-ham 0.25.0 and iso-8601 1.0.3 (#605)

cmaf-ham gets a minor bump. The release removes numberToIso8601Duration, adds @svta/cml-dash and @svta/cml-iso-8601 as peer dependencies, and makes Track.url and Period.$.duration optional. iso-8601 gets a patch bump for the decodeIso8601Duration fix, which iso8601DurationToNumber in cmaf-ham relies on. No other package peers on iso-8601, so there is no cascade.
